summary: Specifies a procedure that uses several Path Computation Elements to compute shortest constrained traffic engineering paths across multiple domains. Computation proceeds backward from the destination domain toward the source. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: To plan a trip through several countries, you ask the last country for routes in, then pass the best options back one country at a time until you reach home.
